normalized.result: Yes — that's a complete, trustworthy reset. Clicking the "×" wiped my typed words, put every advanced option back to normal — the label filters, the any/all choice, the exact-phrase tick — and cleared away all those "leaving out / within / matching" reminders, so nothing lingered behind quietly still filtering. And all four bookmarks came back under "All bookmarks." That's just what I'd want: one clear button that fully undoes everything I set up, so I'm never left wondering whether some hidden condition is still trimming my results. When I say "clear," I want a clean slate, and this gives me exactly that. Deeper search is settled — powerful when I want it, and easy to get all the way back out of.
